thread:
elaine: FYI pushed a new 'Provisioning Cookbook' draft that combines the Dedicated quickstart, Terraform snippet, and a small SDK example. seeking quick sanity check before i open the PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/compare/branch/provisioning-cookbook :eyes:
sam: Will take a look in a bit. can you paste the SDK snippet here so i don't have to jump around?
elaine: sure — it's tiny, basically create a reservation + attach policy:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
res = client.dedicated.create_reservation(project='acme', gpus=4, sku='a10', autoscale_policy={'min':1,'max':8})
print(res.id)
```
jordan: small nit: `autoscale_policy` on the Python snippet should match the REST field naming we use elsewhere (`min_replicas`, `max_replicas`) otherwise examples diverge. broke a copy/paste once. :grimacing:
elaine: good catch — i'll update to `min_replicas`/`max_replicas`. also added a terraform example — could someone sanity-check the resource names?
anya: paste terraform here?
elaine: here you go:
```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_reservation" "main" {
  name        = "acme-prod"
  project     = "acme"
  gpus        = 4
  sku         = "a10"
  min_replicas = 1
  max_replicas = 8
  isolation    = "tenant"
}
```
mike: quick thought on `isolation` — our infra team prefers the term `isolation_mode` in tf to avoid collisions with other providers. can we harmonize across docs?
elaine: hmm. the dedicated-terraform examples in other pages use `isolation`. i can add a note: "tf field: isolation_mode (alias `isolation`)" and link to infra's schema.
sam: also, SLA language on the draft currently reads "99.9% uptime typical". legal asked that we explicitly say "SLA applies to Dedicated Reserved capacity when under active commit" and include the measurement window (30d). please update wording.
elaine: thanks — i'll reword to: "SLA: 99.9% availability for reserved Dedicated capacity (measured as successful serving time over a 30-day window). Applies to active committed contracts only." sound ok?
jordan: that's better. also add a short bullet for graceful degradation: fallback to shared-hosted variant if reservation is unavailable (and explain cost/latency impact). ops asked for that.
elaine: added a short sample policy block under 'rollouts & fallbacks'. sample YAML: 
```yaml
rollout_policy:
  primary: reserved-acme
  fallback: hosted-medium
  degrade_strategy: "latency-first" # prefer lower cost over strict latency when fallback
```
anya: link fix: the doc currently points to the old dev-ex repo for `isolation-decorators.md` — that file moved to infra/docs/isolation.md. PR will fail CI if we don't update link.
elaine: thanks — i'll update. also flagged one more: a CLI example uses `redwood reserved create` but the actual CLI is `redwood dedicated create-reservation` (we changed this last quarter).
mike: tiny style note — keep examples under 80 cols where possible. some of the HCL blocks in the draft are >120 and look bad in the rendered page.
elaine: good call — i'll wrap/shorten. planning to open the PR in ~30m. any other blockers?
sam: can you add a short migration checklist for users moving from shared -> dedicated? like: quota requests, certs for private deployments, rolling over model versions, KV cache warming. one sentence per item.
elaine: added a 'migration checklist' section with 6 bullets — i'll paste once PR is up.
docs-bot: PR opened by elaine: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4621 — "Provisioning Cookbook: TF + SDK + migration checklist" :white_check_mark:
sam: reviewing now. saw one more mismatch in the REST example: header should be `X-Redwood-Project` not `X-Project`.
elaine: fixed in branch. thanks.
jordan: LGTM apart from one concern — the autoscale example doesn't mention cooldown windows. ops will want `scale_up_cooldown_s` and `scale_down_cooldown_s`.
elaine: added optional fields and a short paragraph explaining tradeoffs for small models vs long-lived KV-heavy workloads.
anya: i ran the link checker locally — two remaining 404s: the infra schema link (will update to infra/docs/schema/reservations.md) and a blog link that 301s.
elaine: updated both. PR now has changes: Terraform field alias note, SDK param rename, SLA clarification, fallback sample, scale cooldown fields, and link fixes. anyone object to merging after sam's review? :thumbsup:
sam: no objections. merging after quick pass.
docs-bot: PR merged (main) by sam: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4621 — Deploy scheduled to staging.
elaine: thanks all. i'll watch staging for the render and open a tiny follow-up PR if anything breaks.
mike: thanks, great documentation effort — this will help onboarding a lot. :clap:
